objective: Independently test CW-11 periodic worker review, busy/user/pause policy, evidence-based hang classification, usage reporting, and actual OMP longevity.
required_attacks: Clock edges before/exactly/after 60 seconds, large jumps, run identity replacement, inactive run, non-monotonic/invalid clocks, and no lifetime cap through the 121st review.

Busy/pending/approval/editor/tool/session/generation ambiguity, strict integer fields, latest-only coalescing, user priority, delivery deferred/unknown/exception, duplicate dispatch/replay prevention.
Pause starts no model review while collection/confirmed exit continues; cancel/revoke/unhealthy clears stale pending; immediate exit event is once-only.
Silence and elapsed time alone remain unknown; suspected hang needs explicit live stalled process plus lifecycle evidence; malformed/private facts are excluded.
Usage observed/estimated/unknown remains distinct and unbounded; 13th peer wake and actual OMP 18.2.10 review are processed with cleanup/residue checks.
constraints: Do not modify product, worker tests/probe, workflow/bridge/contracts/docs/artifacts/dependencies, graphify sources, or unrelated files.
Use apply_patch for independent tests. Preserve failing product evidence and report needs_reroute rather than fixing product.
Use `/tmp/cw02-g1-venv/bin/python` with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and PYTHONPATH=src; do not use uv or create local environments/locks/egg-info.
No commit/push/merge/stash/reset/clean. Run graphify update . after test changes and report generated drift separately.
checks: Independent tests, worker observation suite, actual independent OMP probe, workflow/bridge/contracts/G4 regressions, git diff/residue/privacy checks.
report: snapshot/scope audit and candidate_ready or needs_reroute
